verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file returns HTTP 200 at docs.chronicle-labs.com/llms.txt with a structured product summary and links. A second llms.txt at chronicle-labs.com/llms.txt is cited with product descriptions, and doc pages are served as .md files an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and first-party guidance on pointing agents at these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
